name: Wolf apple
desc: A tomato-like fruit that Wikipedia says can make up 40 to 90 percent of the maned wolf's diet and is available all year.
about: Solanum lycocarpum, or wolf apple, is common in the Brazilian Cerrado ecoregion. In Portuguese, the plant is called lobeira (lit. 'wolf's plant') or fruta-do-lobo ('wolf's fruit').
